 * Arm prehide clear helpers + network-aware flicker timer.
 * Expects #at-body-style already in <head> and window.boxPrehideSelectorList.
 * Primary clear is applyOffers; this timer is the backstop (hold until pageLoad).
 */

(function boxAdobeTargetPrehideArm(w, d) {
    const STYLE_ID = 'at-body-style';
    const log = typeof w.boxAdobeTargetLog === 'function' ? w.boxAdobeTargetLog.bind(w) : () => {};

    w.adobeTargetBodyHidingEnabled = true;

    const clearPrehideTimer = () => {
        if (w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideTimer) {
            w.clearTimeout(w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideTimer);
            w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideTimer = null;
        }
    };

    const resolveTimeout = () => {
        const connection =
            w.navigator && (w.navigator.connection || w.navigator.mozConnection || w.navigator.webkitConnection);
        const info = { hasConnectionApi: !!connection };
        const hardMs = 24000;
        let softMs;
        if (!connection) {
            softMs = 8000;
            info.bucket = 'unknown';
        } else {
            info.effectiveType = connection.effectiveType;
            info.rtt = connection.rtt;
            info.downlink = connection.downlink;
            info.saveData = !!connection.saveData;
            const rtt = Number(connection.rtt) || 0;
            let downlink = Number(connection.downlink);
            if (Number.isNaN(downlink)) {
                downlink = -1;
            }
            const type = connection.effectiveType || '4g';
            if (connection.saveData) {
                softMs = 10000;
                info.bucket = 'saveData';
            } else if (type === 'slow-2g' || type === '2g' || rtt >= 1400 || (downlink >= 0 && downlink <= 0.5)) {
                softMs = 14000;
                info.bucket = '2g';
            } else if (type === '3g' || rtt >= 400 || (downlink >= 0 && downlink <= 1.6)) {
                softMs = 12000;
                info.bucket = 'slow-4g-or-3g';
            } else if (rtt >= 150 || (downlink >= 0 && downlink <= 5)) {
                softMs = 8000;
                info.bucket = 'mid';
            } else {
                softMs = 4000;
                info.bucket = 'fast';
            }
        }
        return { softMs, hardMs, info };
    };

    w.boxAdobeTargetClearPrehide = reason => {
        clearPrehideTimer();
        const el = d.getElementById(STYLE_ID);
        if (el && el.parentNode) {
            el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
            log(`prehide cleared${reason ? ` (${reason})` : ''}`);
            return;
        }
        log(`prehide already gone${reason ? ` (${reason})` : ''}`);
    };

    w.preHideMethods = {
        removeStyle: () => {
            w.boxAdobeTargetClearPrehide('preHideMethods');
        },
        getParent: () => d.getElementsByTagName('head')[0],

    };

    const resolved = resolveTimeout();
    const { softMs, hardMs } = resolved;
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideFlickerMs = softMs;
    w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideHardCapMs = hardMs;
    w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideTimerArmed = true;
    w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideNetwork = resolved.info;

        hardMs,
        network: resolved.info,
    });

    const targetPageLoadSettled = () => !!w.boxAdobeTargetPageLoadFired && !w.boxAdobeTargetPageLoadInFlight;

    const onSoftTimer = () => {
        w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideTimer = null;
        if (!d.getElementById(STYLE_ID)) {
            return;
        }
        const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;
        if (!targetPageLoadSettled() && elapsed < hardMs) {
            const holdFor = Math.min(1000, hardMs - elapsed);
            log('prehide timer hold (Target pageLoad not settled)', {
                elapsed,
                holdFor,
                hardMs,
                bucket: resolved.info.bucket,
            });
            w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideTimer = w.setTimeout(onSoftTimer, holdFor);

        }
        w.boxAdobeTargetClearPrehide(
            `flicker-timer soft=${softMs}ms hard=${hardMs}ms elapsed=${elapsed}ms bucket=${resolved.info.bucket}`,

    };

    w.__boxAdobeTargetPrehideTimer = w.setTimeout(onSoftTimer, softMs);

<script type="text/javascript">const infoNoticeInit = () => {
    // Create initial styling elements.
    const newStyle = document.createElement('style');
    newStyle.type = 'text/css';
    newStyle.id = 'info-notice-style';

    // If boxBootstrap is available, check for Cookie information.
    /* eslint-disable no-undef */
    if (boxBootstrap && boxBootstrap.infoNotices) {
        Object.keys(boxBootstrap.infoNotices).forEach(id => {
            const rev = boxBootstrap.infoNotices[id];
            const cookieName = `infoNotice_${id}`;
            const cookieValue = Cookies.get(cookieName);

            // If the ID/Rev matches, then hide hide the specific banner.
            if (typeof cookieValue !== 'undefined' && cookieValue === rev) {
                const hideNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
                    `.info-notice[data-rev-id="${rev}"], .info-notice-carousel[data-rev-id="${rev}"] { display: none !important; }`,
                );
                newStyle.appendChild(hideNoticeStyling);
            }
        });
    }

    // Fallback to show the banner.
    const showNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
        '.info-notice.info-notice__top, .info-notice.info-notice__bottom, .info-notice-carousel { display: block; }',
    );
    newStyle.appendChild(showNoticeStyling);
    document.head.appendChild(newStyle);
};

infoNoticeInit();
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">// eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
class InfoNoticeCarouselControls {
    constructor(element) {
        if (!element) return;

        this.element = element;
        this.bannerContent = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-item');
        this.bannerColors = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-background-color');
        this.navContainer = element.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel-controls');
        this.prev = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_left');
        this.next = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_right');
        this.contentCount = this.bannerContent.length;
        this.autoplay = element.classList.contains('autoplay');
        this.autoplayer = null;
        this.pauseEvent = null;
        this.timer = element.dataset.timer ? parseInt(element.dataset.timer, 10) : 3300;
        this.active = {
            aInternal: 0,
            aListener() {},
            set v(val) {
                this.aInternal = val;
                this.aListener(val);
            },
            get v() {
                return this.aInternal;
            },
            registerListener(listener) {
                this.aListener = listener;
            },
        };

        this.setNav();
    }

    setAutoPlay() {
        const self = this;
        if (this.autoplay) {
            this.autoplayer = setInterval(() => {
                self.goNext();
            }, this.timer);
        }
    }

    debounce(func) {
        const self = this;
        clearInterval(self.autoplayer);

        return (event => {
            if (self.pauseEvent) clearTimeout(self.pauseEvent);
            self.pauseEvent = setTimeout(func, 500, event);
        })();
    }

    setNav() {
        const self = this;

        const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[0]?.dataset?.textColor;
        this.navContainer.classList.add(currentTextColor);

        this.active.registerListener(this.updateActive.bind(this));

        this.setAutoPlay();

        // Set click listeners on arrows.
        if (this.prev && this.next) {
            this.prev.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goPrev();
            });
            this.next.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goNext();
            });
        }

        // Set pause/unpause on hover.
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
        });
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            self.setAutoPlay();
        });

        // Activate whichever banner receives keyboard focus.
        this.element.addEventListener('focusin', event => {
            clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
            const item = event.target.closest('.info-notice-carousel-item');
            if (!item) return;

            const index = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(self.bannerContent, item);
            if (index !== -1 && index !== self.active.v) {
                self.active.v = index;
            }

            // Focusing an off-screen banner scrolls the overflow:hidden container.
            const content = item.parentElement;
            content.scrollTop = 0;
        });
        this.element.addEventListener('focusout', event => {
            if (!self.element.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.setAutoPlay();
            }
        });

        // Prevent autoplaying while resizing. Recalculates banner height.
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            self.debounce(self.setAutoPlay.bind(self));
        });
    }

    updateActive(val) {
        let textColor = '';

        for (let i = 0; i < this.contentCount; i += 1) {
            this.bannerContent[i].classList.remove('active');
            this.bannerColors[i].classList.remove('active');
            const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            if (currentTextColor) {
                this.navContainer.classList.remove(currentTextColor);
            }
            if (i === val) {
                this.bannerContent[i].classList.add('active');
                this.bannerColors[i].classList.add('active');
                textColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            }
        }

        if (textColor) {
            this.navContainer.classList.add(textColor);
        }
    }

    goPrev() {
        if (this.active.v > 0) {
            this.active.v -= 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = this.contentCount - 1;
        }
    }

    goNext() {
        if (this.active.v < this.contentCount - 1) {
            this.active.v += 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = 0;
        }
    }
}
</script>

(function () {
  const TARGET   = 'Content'; // word to target in the h1 (update for translation)
  const WORDS    = ['Content', 'Contracts', 'Research', 'Campaigns', 'Data rooms', 'Reports', 'Designs', 'Presentations', 'Invoices', 'Knowledge', 'Proposals'];
  const INTERVAL = 3000;
  const DURATION = 450;
  const MIN_W    = 425;

  // Fallback gradient if the header has none we can read (matches the old snippet)
  const FALLBACK = { direction: '90deg', stops: [
    { rgb: [225, 173, 74], pos: '' },   // #E1AD4A
    { rgb: [201, 55, 228], pos: '' },   // #C937E4
  ]};

  const CLS = {
    rotator: 'hero-rotator',
    word:    'hero-rotator__word',
    suffix:  'hero-rotator__suffix',
    sizer:   'hero-rotator__sizer',
  };

  const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const ease = (t) => (t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2);

  // ── Gradient parsing: read the header's own gradient so the words match it ──
  const splitTop = (s) => {
    const out = []; let depth = 0, buf = '';
    for (const ch of s) {
      if (ch === '(') depth++;
      else if (ch === ')') depth--;
      if (ch === ',' && depth === 0) { out.push(buf); buf = ''; }
      else buf += ch;
    }
    if (buf.trim()) out.push(buf);
    return out;
  };
  const toRGB = (c) => {
    c = c.trim();
    let m = c.match(/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/i);
    if (m) { const n = m[1].split(/[,\s/]+/).map(parseFloat); return [n[0] || 0, n[1] || 0, n[2] || 0]; }
    m = c.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3,8})$/i);
    if (m) {
      let h = m[1];
      if (h.length === 3 || h.length === 4) h = h.split('').map((x) => x + x).join('');
      return [parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16), parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16)];
    }
    return null;
  };
  const parseGradient = (str) => {
    const m = str && str.match(/linear-gradient\((.*)\)/i);
    if (!m) return null;
    const parts = splitTop(m[1]);
    if (!parts.length) return null;
    let direction = '90deg', colorParts = parts;
    if (!/rgb|#/i.test(parts[0])) { direction = parts[0].trim(); colorParts = parts.slice(1); }
    const stops = [];
    for (const p of colorParts) {
      const cm = p.trim().match(/(rgba?\([^)]*\)|#[0-9a-f]+)\s*(.*)$/i);
      if (!cm) continue;
      const rgb = toRGB(cm[1]);
      if (rgb) stops.push({ rgb, pos: cm[2].trim() });
    }
    return stops.length >= 2 ? { direction, stops } : null;
  };

  // State
  let target, originalHTML, originalStyle, gInfo;
  let wordStops, suffixStops;
  let sizer, rotator, suffixEl;
  let current, next;
  let wordHeight, idx;
  let busy    = false;
  let running = false;
  let intervalId, resizeTimer, rafId;

  // Build a gradient from a subset of stops at a given alpha (positions dropped
  // so each segment distributes its slice evenly across its own width)
  const buildGrad = (stops, a) =>
    `linear-gradient(${gInfo.direction}, ` +
    stops.map((s) => `rgba(${s.rgb[0]},${s.rgb[1]},${s.rgb[2]},${a})`).join(', ') + ')';

  // Split the header gradient so the word gets stops 1->2 and the suffix 2->3,
  // meeting at a shared color for a seamless look. Synthesizes a midpoint for
  // two-stop gradients.
  const splitStops = () => {
    const n = gInfo.stops.length;
    if (n >= 3) {
      const mid = Math.floor(n / 2);
      wordStops   = gInfo.stops.slice(0, mid + 1);
      suffixStops = gInfo.stops.slice(mid);
    } else {
      const a = gInfo.stops[0].rgb;
      const b = gInfo.stops[n - 1].rgb;
      const midC = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => Math.round((a[i] + b[i]) / 2));
      wordStops   = [{ rgb: a }, { rgb: midC }];
      suffixStops = [{ rgb: midC }, { rgb: b }];
    }
  };

  const slide = (el, yPct) => { el.style.top = `${yPct}%`; };                  // no stacking context
  const fade  = (el, a)    => { el.style.backgroundImage = buildGrad(wordStops, a); }; // fades the actual paint

  const makeWord = (txt) => {
    const el = document.createElement('span');
    el.className = CLS.word;
    el.textContent = txt;
    return el;
  };

  const syncSizer = () => {
    const cs = window.getComputedStyle(target);
    sizer.style.fontFamily    = cs.fontFamily;
    sizer.style.fontSize      = cs.fontSize;
    sizer.style.fontWeight    = cs.fontWeight;
    sizer.style.letterSpacing = cs.letterSpacing;
  };
  const measure = (word) => { sizer.textContent = word; return sizer.offsetWidth; };

  const setup = () => {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;

    // Capture the header gradient BEFORE neutralizing, then reuse it on the leaves
    gInfo = parseGradient(window.getComputedStyle(target).backgroundImage) || FALLBACK;
    splitStops();

    // Neutralize the h1's own clip so it stops painting its gradient onto descendants
    target.style.backgroundImage       = 'none';
    target.style.webkitBackgroundClip  = 'border-box';
    target.style.backgroundClip        = 'border-box';

    sizer = document.createElement('span');
    sizer.className = CLS.sizer;
    sizer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.appendChild(sizer);

    current = makeWord(WORDS[0]);
    next    = makeWord('\u00a0');

    slide(current, 0);                        fade(current, 1);   // visible, in place
    slide(next, prefersReduced ? 0 : 100);    fade(next, 0);       // parked / invisible

    rotator = document.createElement('span');
    rotator.className = CLS.rotator;
    rotator.append(current, next);

    // Rebuild the header: rotator + static gradient suffix (e.g. " + AI")
    const suffix = target.textContent.trim().slice(TARGET.length);
    target.textContent = '';
    target.appendChild(rotator);
    if (suffix) {
      suffixEl = document.createElement('span');
      suffixEl.className = CLS.suffix;
      suffixEl.textContent = suffix;
      suffixEl.style.backgroundImage = buildGrad(suffixStops, 1);
      target.appendChild(suffixEl);
    }

    syncSizer();
    wordHeight           = current.offsetHeight;
    rotator.style.height = `${wordHeight}px`;
    rotator.style.width  = `${measure(WORDS[0])}px`;

    idx        = 0;
    intervalId = setInterval(tick, INTERVAL);
  };

  const teardown = () => {
    if (!running) return;
    running = false;
    clearInterval(intervalId);
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    sizer?.remove();
    sizer = null;
    target.innerHTML = originalHTML;
    if (originalStyle !== null) target.setAttribute('style', originalStyle);
    else target.removeAttribute('style');
  };

  const tick = () => {
    if (busy) return;
    busy = true;

    idx = (idx + 1) % WORDS.length;
    next.textContent = WORDS[idx];
    slide(next, prefersReduced ? 0 : 100);    // start position for incoming word
    rotator.style.width = `${measure(WORDS[idx])}px`;

    const startTime = performance.now();
    const step = (now) => {
      if (!running) return;
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - startTime) / DURATION);
      const e = ease(t);

      fade(current, 1 - e);
      fade(next, e);
      if (!prefersReduced) {
        slide(current, -100 * e);
        slide(next, 100 - 100 * e);
      }

      if (t < 1) { rafId = requestAnimationFrame(step); return; }

      // Park the outgoing word (invisible), reset its slide, swap roles
      current.textContent = '\u00a0';
      fade(current, 0);
      slide(current, prefersReduced ? 0 : 100);
      [current, next] = [next, current];
      busy = false;
    };
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };

  const onResize = () => {
    if (window.innerWidth < MIN_W) { teardown(); return; }
    if (!running) { setup(); return; }
    if (!busy) {
      syncSizer();
      wordHeight           = current.offsetHeight;
      rotator.style.height = `${wordHeight}px`;
      rotator.style.width  = `${measure(current.textContent.trim())}px`;
    }
  };

  const start = () => {
    const h1 = document.querySelector('.hero h1');
    if (!h1) return;
    const candidates = [...h1.querySelectorAll('*'), h1];
    target = candidates.find((el) => el.textContent.trim().startsWith(TARGET));
    if (!target) return;

    originalHTML  = target.innerHTML;
    originalStyle = target.getAttribute('style');

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (running && window.innerWidth < MIN_W) {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        teardown();
        return;
      }
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(onResize, 150);
    });

    if (window.innerWidth >= MIN_W) setup();
  };

  document.readyState === 'loading'
    ? document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start)
    : start();
})();
